name: micky-psych-tools
description: Personal Claude Code plugins for clinical psychiatry, evidence appraisal, and pre-build alignment.

plugins.name: pubmed-research-note
plugins.description: Answers a clinical question from primary literature. Quantified, adjudicated, trial-registry-checked evidence reports with a clearly marked verdict and full per-study depth, in whatever shape serves the question — decision-shaped or topic-shaped. Runs the intent-lock plugin first to lock the question, then renders the report inline and files it to the vault by default; atomic notes on request.

plugins.name: intent-lock
plugins.description: Interrogate a request until it has exactly one reading, then build it. Uncapped rounds, a compounding misread ledger, silent convergence gates.

plugins.name: plugin-creator
plugins.description: Plugin lifecycle toolkit for this marketplace. /new-plugin scaffolds a new plugin (elicit checklist, generate component skeleton, register, validate); /refine-plugin audits and refines an existing plugin or skill, then bumps and validates. /route regenerates ROUTING.md and routes a request to the owning skill or command.

plugins.name: vault-keeper
plugins.description: Files, indexes, links, and retrieves any skill's output in the shared Obsidian-style vault at the marketplace repo root (vault/). The single place everything lands. Five jobs: init, save, index, query, empty — the empty-vault skill (+ /empty-vault) drains the vault into the Learn hub via learn-hub's digest-report skill, deleting only after a verified sync.

plugins.name: psych-paper-digest
plugins.description: Multi-domain literature surveillance on a personal watchlist. Sweeps PubMed and ClinicalTrials.gov for what appeared since the last sweep and delivers a triaged, read-once digest — practice-changing first, worth-reading next, noise suppressed with counts. Hands practice-changing items to pubmed-research-note and vault saves to vault-keeper.

plugins.name: comprehensive-review
plugins.description: Whole-disorder academic literature reviews of psychiatric topics — textbook-chapter breadth across every coverage domain (epidemiology to prognosis), with the chapter's structure designed to fit the topic and load-bearing studies in full per-study depth, never silently narrowed to a treatment essay. Gated by intent-lock, searches PubMed and ClinicalTrials.gov itself, files the finished md review to the vault via vault-keeper.

plugins.name: clinical-infographic
plugins.description: Renders a sourced clinical evidence report into a print-ready medical summary infographic for clinical reference — one self-contained HTML file with color-coded columns, stat tiles, and a mandatory contraindications / "medications to avoid" banner. Ships no search engines: it never invents a clinical fact. Reuses or first generates a report via comprehensive-review or pubmed-research-note, then files the HTML to the vault via vault-keeper.

plugins.name: firecrawl
plugins.description: Firecrawl onboarding and routing for web data: search the web, scrape clean markdown, and interact with live pages via the Firecrawl CLI or API. Routes each request to the right path — live CLI work, app-code integration, web-powered deliverables, credentials, REST-only, or the keyless free tier — and deep-integrates with the pipeline: the general-web evidence engine for pubmed-research-note and comprehensive-review, intent-lock gating on deliverables, vault saves via vault-keeper.

plugins.name: concept-animation
plugins.description: Creates an animation that illustrates a concept — one self-contained HTML file (inline CSS/SVG/JS) that unfolds it scene by scene with synced captions, player controls, and a reduced-motion fallback. Intent-lock is the Step 0 gate. Any concept is in scope, but clinical facts come only from sourced reports (session, vault, or generated first by comprehensive-review / pubmed-research-note). Files the animation to the vault via vault-keeper.

plugins.name: gridgeist
plugins.description: Design, redesign, and review distinctive web interfaces with a strong grid, precise typography, and product-specific visual systems.

plugins.name: code-explainer
plugins.description: Explains given code as one interactive, self-contained HTML page — the source on the left in a VS Code-styled editor (Dark+, line numbers, syntax highlighting), the explanation on the right, cross-linked line by line. Three linked modes: hover/click highlighting, a step-through walkthrough in execution order, and a clickable SVG flow diagram. Source verbatim, real defects named, no invented runtime values. Intent-lock only for ambiguous asks; vault opt-in.

plugins.name: ml-concept-lab
plugins.description: Builds an interactive explorable for a machine-learning, AI, or CS concept — one self-contained HTML file where the real algorithm runs live and the learner drives it (gradient descent, backprop, attention, k-means, Dijkstra, Q-learning). Intent-lock is the Step 0 gate. Every number is computed, not drawn; a self-check panel tests invariants; controls reach the regime where it breaks. Verified headless, filed to the vault via vault-keeper.

plugins.name: decision-interview
plugins.description: Mid-task decision gate: collects every open decision the agent cannot make for the user — scope forks, trade-offs, irreversible steps, missing preferences — and resolves them in one batched option-picker interview instead of scattered questions or silent guesses. Sweeps the task, triages by impact, asks with a recommended option first, and records answers in a decision ledger for the session. Execution-phase sibling of intent-lock.

plugins.name: plan-critique
plugins.description: Adversarial critique of an existing plan that ends in a better plan: nine lenses (goal-fit, gaps, sequencing, feasibility, risk, assumptions, verifiability, simplicity, alternatives) find where it breaks, repairs with one right answer are applied, and every fork only the plan's owner can decide is resolved in a relentless batched option-picker interview. Verdict-first critique + the full revised plan under a decision ledger. One skill (plan-critique) + /critique-plan [plan-or-path].

plugins.name: clinical-minimal
plugins.description: Personal Office design system (Clinical Minimal) for every .docx, .pptx and .xlsx: white page, one clinical-teal accent, Leelawadee UI for Thai + English. Build helpers (cm.py), a per-slide render check driven by PowerPoint (slidecheck.py) and a picture selection algorithm (imgpick.py) that judges Google Images candidates as placed. Decks: English by default, visual on every slide, fade + click builds.

plugins.name: bullet-reconstruct
plugins.description: Distils a dense source (paper, chapter, review, transcript) into scannable bullets with measured, bounded loss under 10%: units frozen from the source before writing, anchor-checked in the output, every number traced back to the source. Keeps figures and tables as image snips cropped from the PDF (vector tables included) and delivers one self-contained HTML file; the .md stays as the vault source. One skill, no commands.

plugins.name: vi-stock-screen-research
plugins.description: Value-investing stock screen and full company review for Thai SET and US stocks. Screen: quality at a fair price on TradingView, ranked top 10, the user picks one ticker. Deep research: TradingView first, Jitta in the user's Chrome when history is short, the 56-1 One Report or 10-K for governance; ships a multi-page Word report and an Excel valuation model in the Clinical Minimal style. intent-lock runs first in both modes. One skill + /vi-screen and /vi-research.

plugins.name: tutor
plugins.description: Teaches new fields like a teacher: a short picker interview before each chunk (what you know, why, how deep), then one small idea per message ('say next'), answer first, anchored to what the learner already owns, with computed examples and code that really ran, numbered next options, no quizzes. Every lesson is saved to a phone-readable Tutor tracker page. Four domain packs: computational psychiatry, Python and R, neural-network architectures, math and statistics notation. One skill + /tutor.

plugins.name: design-md-generator
plugins.description: Generates spec-valid DESIGN.md design-system files (Google Stitch format) from a website, brief, codebase or remixed kit, and applies the active one to every UI and Artifact you build: a SessionStart hook finds the project or personal default DESIGN.md, and design-md-apply turns its tokens into CSS or Tailwind.

plugins.name: idea-to-3d
plugins.description: Turns a one-line character or prop idea into a textured, rigged, animated 3D model (.glb) with a preview sheet: concepts, image-to-3D, rigging and clips on Meshy, finishing in headless Blender 5.2. Before each checkpoint an independent Gemini critic (Antigravity CLI, Claude fallback) reviews the stage and a reviser applies free fixes; fixes that spend credits run only after approval. Five skills, three agents. Needs Windows, Blender 5.2 and agy; bundles the meshy MCP.

plugins.name: learning-map
plugins.description: Turns one material (paper, chapter, lecture, URL, PDF, pasted text) into a learning map: the prerequisite knowledge as a dependency ladder (Level 0 foundations, Level 1 core, Level 2 what the material assumes), learning pearls anchored to the material with numbers checked against its text, and an ordered path of concepts to explore next. Every map is saved to one phone-readable "Learn" artifact.
